limitations: Small frozen-test support for rare labels.
Two-center evidence does not establish broad transportability.
No prospective clinical validation or measured treatment impact.

safe_claims.claim: The verified supervised cohort contains 299 patients.
safe_claims.evidence: One row with all diagnosis targets missing was excluded.

safe_claims.claim: The dataset is multi-label and severely imbalanced.
The other-disease presentation field is a target restatement.
safe_claims.evidence: Presence-indicator AUC is documented in the representation-aware leakage audit.

safe_claims.claim: LAB_AWARE shows at most a small frozen-test macro-F1 edge; PRE_LAB remains the primary operational track.
safe_claims.evidence: PRE_LAB macro-F1=0.476, micro-F1=0.756, macro-PR-AUC=0.539; LAB_AWARE macro-F1=0.478.

safe_claims.claim: Prediction-set evidence is exact only for the uncapped empirical policy.
safe_claims.evidence: Exact and pragmatic modes are reported separately with per-label support.
